值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解無孔微孔濾茶器對於極細茶渣的真實過濾效果與沖泡特性。
  • 學習如何透過高溫火烤的特殊方式，徹底清除濾器內部積累的茶垢與黴菌。
  • 實測驗證陶瓷濾器在烈火燒烤後的耐高溫極限，解答是否會破裂損壞的疑慮。

摘要

神奇無孔濾茶器的過濾實測

作者在下午茶時間拿出放置已久的無孔濾茶器進行測試。為了檢驗其極限過濾性能，作者特地取出父親珍藏且未經洗茶步驟的茶葉直接沖泡，藉此產生最大量的茶渣。實測發現，經濾茶器過濾倒入碗中的茶湯幾乎看不見任何碎屑，證實其阻隔微小殘渣的效果極佳；不過，若依照廣告方式直接將茶葉置於濾器上方沖水，茶湯色澤則會顯得偏淡。

火烤疏通法與耐熱極限挑戰

針對這款濾器長期使用後容易堵塞茶垢的問題，作者親自實測了網路上流傳的高溫火烤疏通法。作者將濾茶器置於火上持續加熱約八分鐘，直到濾器中心因極高溫而熾熱發紅，原本頑固的黑色茶漬在此過程中被碳化燒除，同時達成了殺菌消毒的效果。關火並經過十五分鐘自然冷卻後，作者將其置入水中沖洗，確認濾器完好無損且完全沒有裂紋，作者對此耐用性與效果給予了高度肯定。

================================================

It's three o'clock, time for tea. >> Use this poreless tea strainer to brew; it filters out even the tiniest tea. dregs, so you won't drink a single leaf. . >> I bought this years ago to film, but I. set it aside. It can easily filter tea. dregs from May 2025.

>> Let's take out the precious tea leaves. my dad collected. >> Well, pour boiling water over our. precious tea; the tea hasn't even been. rinsed, so there should be the most. dregs. Let's use this bowl; it's easier. to see. Let's check if there are any. tea dregs.

>> I feel these tea dregs...These dregs. are negligible, and look, it can filter. out even the smallest particles. In the. ad, they put the tea leaves directly on. top to brew; let's try that too. It's. so hot! >> Okay, let's keep going. >> Let's see if we can brew tea directly.

like this. But brewing it this way,. compared to regular brewing, the tea. color is a bit too pale. However, I saw. other videos online mentioning that. this thing gets clogged with tea. residue over time, and they have a. solution. >> You have to heat it until it's glowing.

red. But I'm curious, won't it crack or. explode if you heat it like that? >> Let it cool naturally first, then wash. it in water, and the core will be. fast-filtered again. >> Let's heat this thing until it's. glowing red just like they did. >> It's going to take a while.

>> It is now 3:34. Oh, look, the flame is. going through, a bit of smoke. Is this. enough? >> This black streak here probably had tea. stains before, and now these tea stains. have been carbonized. By doing this,. the tea dregs are burned off, and any. potential mold is burned to ash in the.

process, which disinfects it. After. heating for eight minutes, if you turn. off the lights, the center is visibly. glowing red. We can barely see the. original black spots anymore. >> Let it cool down naturally first. >> Turn off the heat, wait 15 minutes,. then put it in water to rinse. 15.

minutes are up. Oh, it didn't crack; look, no cracks, it didn't crack at all. . It seems it won't crack if you do it. this way. Honestly, I actually quite. like this, buy it if you need one.

item.title: 廣告說只要30分鐘牙齒就能變得超白 現在都這麼賣貨的嗎？ - 炫白牙貼
item.itunes:title: 廣告說只要30分鐘牙齒就能變得超白 現在都這麼賣貨的嗎？ - 炫白牙貼
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pAVVz3g0F6Q

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解市售熱門炫白牙貼宣稱「30分鐘去黃」的廣告效果是否真實。
  • 探討美白牙貼中過氧化氫與氯化鍶等主要成分的作用與對牙齒的影響。
  • 透過作者親身實測對比，釐清牙齒美白產品的實際見效週期與避免誇大廣告誤導。

摘要

牙貼宣稱快速美白與實測準備

作者針對網路上宣傳「貼30分鐘即可去黃465%」的紫色炫白牙貼進行開箱測試。該產品一盒14片售價79元，為了驗證其宣稱的神奇效果，作者決定只在上排牙齒貼上牙貼，保留下排牙齒作為對照組，並靜待30分鐘以觀察前後差異。

成分分析與使用感受

在敷貼26分鐘時，作者分享牙齒感覺偶爾會有輕微的酸感滲透。作者查詢成分發現，產品主要含有過氧化氫（雙氧水）與氯化鍶；前者負責漂白美白，但可能輕微損傷牙釉質，後者則有助於抗敏、降低牙齒敏感度。作者指出正常且適度使用下通常問題不大。

實測成果揭曉與廣告真實性

時間結束並漱口後，作者對比上下排牙齒，發現幾乎沒有明顯區別。作者表示這類產品通常需要持續使用7至14天的完整療程才可能見效，廣告中宣稱短短半小時就能瞬間變白的說法顯然過於誇大不實。

=============

item.itunes:title: 老演員？！怎麼又是你？以前4塊4一罐？現在80塊一罐了？！ - 蟹黃醬2026
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GMYQfDi6gJs

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭開網購蟹黃醬從低價劣質品到高價升級版的真實品質差異。
  • 學習如何透過成分標籤的排序邏輯來判斷食品的真材實料程度。
  • 了解市售罐裝蟹黃醬與實體名店現做蟹黃麵的口感差距與性價比分析，避免衝動消費踩雷。

摘要

黑心劣質蟹黃醬的慘痛回憶

作者回憶起兩年半前曾購買過極為廉價的蟹黃醬，當時一罐僅售價 4.4 元人民幣。然而，那罐產品內容物混雜不堪，充斥著廉價的蛋黃與類似魚卵的雜質，不僅毫無蟹肉香氣，而且腥味濃烈難耐，令人難以入口。這段糟糕的踩雷經歷讓作者對網購蟹黃醬留下了深刻的陰影。

老店家推出升級版「六隻大蟹」高價回歸

  • 見證作者意外買錯整人惡臭噴霧，導致全家人被燻到淚流滿面、緊急逃難的幽默插曲。
  • 揭曉網路瘋傳的「誘食神級噴霧」對挑食狗狗究竟是否真有神奇成效。

摘要

挑食愛犬與神秘噴霧的由來

作者的愛犬 Taizou 最近出現了嚴重的挑食問題，寧可天天啃樹葉或暴風吸入零食，也堅決不肯碰碗裡的狗糧。為了解決這項難題，作者聽取養狗朋友的建議，決定購入網路上據說能利用獨特氣味激發狗狗食慾的特殊氣味噴霧來進行實測。

誤買整人噴霧引發的慘劇

然而出師不利，作者的妻子不小心買成了整人用的惡臭噴霧。當作者試著打開時，惡臭瞬間沾上手指並瀰漫四周，愛犬 Taizou 當場嚇得落荒而逃，全家人更被燻到眼淚直流，不得不敞開門窗奔向戶外避難，場面極度混亂失控。

正版誘食噴霧實測與殘酷結局

三天後，作者秉持嚴謹態度買來與影片一模一樣的正版噴霧。這款產品散發出飼料伴隨大蒜的香氣，狗狗聞了之後果然沒有逃跑。作者滿懷期待地將噴霧噴在狗糧上並架設鏡頭觀察，沒想到 Taizou 僅僅上前嗅了嗅便轉身離開，對狗糧依舊毫無興趣，反倒轉頭興高采烈地吃起零食，宣告這場誘食實驗徹底破局。

================================================

It all started because Lumi recently. became a picky eater and stopped liking. dog food. >> Our dog Taizou has the exact same. symptoms as the dog in that video:. eating, eating, eating. But he won't. even touch his dog food. >> Yet he never goes hungry. >> Why eat anything else, you're eating. charcoal!

>> It's not like he's full; just offer him. a treat and you'll see. Look, he's. eating it with such gusto, and quite a. lot of it too. >> He’d rather eat green leaves every. day than touch his kibble. >> He eats leaves, too. Yeah. I shared. this with my fellow dog-owner friend,. and this "genius" solemnly told me that. a foul-smelling spray is safe and.

practical. >> If we spray this stuff on dog food,. will it make our dog love eating it? >> The dogs seem quite obsessed with this. scent. >> Let's buy some and try it out. It...it. doesn't seem to be the same thing. >> Everyone looks miserable; why does it. feel like a prank prop? Is it the same. one? It looks different from the.

advertisement. My wife bought the wrong. one; their spray says "Smell for Hell" —a hellish scent that's supposed to. be awful. We got this bottle instead,. which says "Stinky Spray." It should be. the same type of thing as the one in. the video. I think we can test this. bottle first, and if it doesn't work. well, we'll go buy their "Hell" spray. Alright, it's open. Wow, my hand got.

some on it and it smells like death. Let's see if our Taizou likes this. scent. Okay, got it. He hates it,. absolutely hates it—he ran so far. away! Hey, why did everyone run outside. ? Come here, wife, take a sniff. >> Look, it's making my eyes water; look,. the windows and doors are open. Three. days later, to ensure our channel’s. rigorous standards, we bought the exact.

same one from that video. The female. host in the video sprayed it on her. hand and sniffed it, saying she felt. nothing. I'm not as brave as her, so. we’ll spray it on paper and take a. whiff. Isn't this just a feed-like,. garlicky smell? No wonder dogs like the. scent. Now, let's let Taizou have a. sniff and see if he likes it. How is it. ? He didn't run away as fiercely as.

last time. Let's spray it on his dog. food to see if he thinks it’s a good. seasoning. Put the bowl on his stand,. set up a camera, and let’s see if he. actually eats it or not. You aren't... >> He just took a sniff, but it didn't. seem to interest him, then he looked. away—he wasn't really into it. Wow,. look at how much he's enjoying those. snacks!
